request.prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated full-body production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, faithfully reproducing the specific original game model shown in the attached reference images. Realistic game-render finish, crisp silhouette, even neutral illumination, exact material colors and original proportions. Preserve all original side-specific features. One subject and one view only, not a montage or multi-view sheet. Keep the complete silhouette and every extremity inside the canvas with generous transparent margin on all sides. Transparent RGBA background, no environment, floor plane or cast floor shadow, no text or publisher marks. No redesigned details, extra equipment or new body parts. Static image only.

Subject: the standard Remnant Destroyer from Mass Effect: Andromeda, the machine shown in Mathew Makin's attached three-view game-model sheet. Use the LEFTMOST figure as the pose guide. Preserve the large broad upper assembly, the paired heavy box-shaped side turrets with slanted gunmetal outer housings, small central weapon and layered mechanical core, narrow articulated central column, and all short spread mechanical ground-support legs exactly as seen. Preserve the original gray/silver weathered plates, dark seams, small white-cyan lights and the distinct angular Remnant panel shapes. The complete upper turrets and every support-foot tip must fit inside the canvas. Match the original camera, facing toward image-left in a mild three-quarter view. No red target-outline effect, no muzzle flash, no extra turrets, no generic humanoid arms, no change to the support-leg arrangement.
